product_one_liner.value: Ordway automates subscription and usage-based billing, payment collection, revenue recognition, and financial reporting for finance teams at SaaS, cloud, fintech, and other recurring-revenue businesses.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing-plan page or pricing navigation link was found; the pricing URL returned no page, and Ordway directs prospects to request a current proposal.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains finance, billing, product, and buyer-education content, not an engineering-authored series about building Ordway; technical support guides do not constitute an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The public support portal contains numerous product articles and developer guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public Product Manager – AI Finance posting defines AI/ML features, model evaluation, and LLM/NLP workflows; it is not an AI-sales position. The posting remains publicly available without a closed notice.

model_provider.notes: Explicitly disclosed for the Claude/MCP assistant integration; this does not establish the model behind every embedded AI feature.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 is a completed independent audit. GDPR is listed as a compliance claim, not a separately awarded certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 5, 2026: access to $20 million in additional equity and debt, led by Harbert Growth Partners with debt participation from Western Alliance Bank; no numbered series is specified.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A publicly available Account Executive posting describes a full-cycle sales role based remotely in the San Francisco Bay Area; no closed notice is shown.

launched_6mo.notes: Ordway Payments launched July 22, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026; it unifies billing and payments with automated reconciliation.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Mike Miele joined as Vice President of Sales, announced April 1, 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Account Executive posting names Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Chilipiper as sales tools. HubSpot is a documented CRM integration, not proof of Ordway’s own internal deployment.
